notes.title: Major update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9054149/05d87dc749f55e6805e98f20ebf9f891589c4523.png  

 Today is the day where we announce the first major (HUGE) update to Spacecorn, an update so big that it required that we rewrite the WHOLE game from scratch. An update was launched just minutes ago that ported Spacecorn to C, a sizable upgrade from batch which the original game ran on.
   Ever since the launch of the game we've been battling with antiviruses that falsely flagged our game as a trojan/virus/malware, and if anyone remembers, I wrote in a forum post that it would take a rewrite in another language to avoid such flags.

 Here's what changed:

    ːSpaceUnicornː Complete rewrite of the game
    ːSpaceUnicornː Grammatical fixes
    ːSpaceUnicornː More text colours
    ːSpaceUnicornː New save system
    ːSpaceUnicornː Minor bugfixes
    ːSpaceUnicornː Fixed route errors
    ːSpaceUnicornː Further improvements to overall system stability 



The game still looks largely the same, but it's now much easier to work on so it'll make updating the game easier.
As always, the game is open-source so if you want to take a peek at what's going on under the hood, please take a gander at our  github, everything we do is always there before coming to Steam.

notes.title: (Late) Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Can you believe it has already been one year since we released Spacecorn? To celebrate this event (that we totally didn't forget) we updated our game!
You can check the changelog and download the entire source code here

We heard you loud and clear that many antiviruses keep detecting our game as a virus, hopefully this release will minimize that, but there are still many antiviruses that will flag any .bat file willy nilly. Anyway, we ran our files through Virustotal and a couple of them came positive, we've contacted them to see what we can do to get our files whitelisted, until then you'll just have to do it yourself.

notes.title: New Update!
notes.content:
Holy crap, I'm bloody exhausted, but I believe everything is working now.
We had a couple problems publishing this update, but I'm 99% certain that everything is working now and if not, just shoot me (osga21) a message and I'll try and sort everything out for you.
Well, onto the patch notes:

     Added an option to change text color
     Fixed several crashes and redundancies
     Changed some portions of the text and fixed a few spelling errors


P.S.: If you're having trouble starting the game, try deleting the game content, exiting steam, opening steam and reinstalling spacecorn, that should sort things out. If it doesn't, try messing around with your antivirus software. If you have any questions feel free to ask.

Once again, I'm terribly sorry for this inconvenience.
